keyPoints.en: PKM founded in 1930; aimed to create a communist republic.
keyPoints.bm: PKM ditubuhkan pada 1930; bertujuan mewujudkan republik komunis.

keyPoints.en: During WWII it led the MPAJA and gained weapons and influence.
keyPoints.bm: Semasa Perang Dunia Kedua ia memimpin MPAJA dan memperoleh senjata serta pengaruh.

keyPoints.en: After the war it used strikes, then armed violence.
keyPoints.bm: Selepas perang ia menggunakan mogok, kemudian keganasan bersenjata.

keyPoints.en: June 1948: three European planters killed at Sungai Siput, Perak.
keyPoints.bm: Jun 1948: tiga pengurus ladang Eropah dibunuh di Sungai Siput, Perak.

keyPoints.en: Emergency declared in 1948; PKM banned; it ended on 31 July 1960.
keyPoints.bm: Darurat diisytiharkan pada 1948; PKM diharamkan; tamat pada 31 Julai 1960.

keyPoints.en: Called "Emergency" so insurance for estates and mines remained valid.
keyPoints.bm: Dipanggil "Darurat" supaya insurans ladang dan lombong kekal sah.

keyPoints.en: Briggs Plan (1950): New Villages cut supplies to the communists.
keyPoints.bm: Rancangan Briggs (1950): Kampung Baru memutuskan bekalan kepada komunis.

keyPoints.en: Gurney killed (1951); Templer (1952) used "hearts and minds".
keyPoints.bm: Gurney dibunuh (1951); Templer (1952) menggunakan "hati dan fikiran".

keyPoints.en: ID cards, curfews, food control, Home Guard, rewards for surrender.
keyPoints.bm: Kad pengenalan, perintah berkurung, kawalan makanan, Home Guard, ganjaran untuk menyerah diri.

tip.en: Two-part answers: name the step, then say HOW it weakened the communists.
tip.bm: Jawapan dua bahagian: namakan langkah, kemudian nyatakan BAGAIMANA ia melemahkan komunis.

keyPoints.en: Politics: sped up independence and inter-ethnic cooperation.
keyPoints.bm: Politik: mempercepat kemerdekaan dan kerjasama antara kaum.

keyPoints.en: Economy: high defence spending; estates and mines attacked.
keyPoints.bm: Ekonomi: belanja pertahanan tinggi; ladang dan lombong diserang.

keyPoints.en: Society: New Villages, fear, loss of life (e.g. Bukit Kepong, 1950).
keyPoints.bm: Sosial: Kampung Baru, ketakutan, kehilangan nyawa (cth. Bukit Kepong, 1950).

keyPoints.en: The PKM finally laid down arms in the Hat Yai Peace Agreement (1989).
keyPoints.bm: PKM akhirnya meletakkan senjata melalui Perjanjian Damai Hat Yai (1989).
